items.title: Free credit incentives for pay-per-use accounts
items.text: Pay-per-use accounts can now earn free X API credits two ways: a one-time $20 when an account saves its first eligible payment card, and a one-time match of the first successful auto-recharge, up to $50 . A new account that earns both receives $70 in free credits. Credits are applied automatically with no code or form, appear in the Developer Console within about a minute, are spent before purchased credits, and expire 3 months after they are granted. The incentives are rolling out now.

items.title: Grok Voice 2.0 deprecation
items.text: grok-voice-2.0 is deprecated. To upgrade, set model to grok-voice-3.0 or grok-voice-latest , at the same price. See Upgrading from Grok Voice 2.0.

items.title: Grok Voice 3.0 is available
items.text: grok-voice-3.0 is now available with Speech to Speech, at the same price as Grok Voice 2.0. grok-voice-latest now points to grok-voice-3.0 , so sessions that use the alias are upgraded automatically. The API is unchanged. To get started, see the Speech to Speech docs.

items.title: grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 end of life
items.text: grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 is deprecated and reaches end of life on October 2, 2026. All requests to that slug are routed to grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 at the same price, with higher accuracy. See the Speech to Text docs.

items.title: Real-time reply moderation guide now uses Grok
items.text: We rewrote the Manage replies in real time integration guide. It now receives replies through the X Activity API post.reply.create event, classifies each reply with Grok through the xAI API using structured outputs, and hides high-confidence violations with the Hide Replies endpoint. The previous version relied on the deprecated Perspective API and the Account Activity API.

items.text: Today, we added the broadcast.chat.remove event to the X Activity API . items.title: Migrate OAuth 1.0a user tokens to OAuth 2.0 with token exchange
items.text: Apps with existing OAuth 1.0a users can now exchange each user’s stored OAuth 1.0a access token and secret for an OAuth 2.0 access token and refresh token, with no consent screen or re-authorization. Send grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange to POST /2/oauth2/token ; the granted scopes are derived from the permissions the user originally authorized, and offline.access is always included.

items.title: safety\_identifier request field
items.text: You can now send safety identifier , an opaque end-user identifier assigned by your application, on Chat Completions, the Responses API, deferred chat completions, the Batch API, and the gRPC GetCompletionsRequest . It lets SpaceXAI attribute a policy violation to one of your end users rather than to your API key. The legacy user field is still accepted. See the Security FAQ.

items.title: Grok 4.7
items.text: Grok 4.7, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API as grok-4.7 . It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text-only output, and no text output limit. Pricing is $2 / $0.50 / $6 per 1M tokens (input / cached input / output) below 200k prompt tokens, and $4 / $1 / $12 above. Reasoning effort supports low, medium, high (default), and xhigh. On the Responses API, grok-4.7 always returns reasoning.encrypted content , even

items.title: grok-imagine-image-quality retirement on November 2
items.text: On November 2, 2026, grok-imagine-image-quality is retired. Requests to the slug will be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 with quality set to low , with no change to the request or response shape and at a lower per-image price. grok-imagine-image (1.0) is not affected. See the migration guide.

items.title: Imagine image API updates
items.text: Auto quality. The quality parameter on grok-imagine-image-2.0 now accepts auto , and the default when quality is omitted has moved from medium to auto . Auto currently uses low for image generation and medium for image editing. Images are billed at the quality they are served at. Pass low or medium explicitly to pin a specific quality. See Image Generation. Five reference images. Image editing now accepts up to 5 source images per request (was 3). See Multi-Image Editing. New aspect ratios. Imag

items.title: Grok 4.6
items.text: Grok 4.6, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API. It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text-only output, and no text output limit. Pricing is $2 / $0.50 / $6 per 1M tokens (input / cached input / output) below 200k prompt tokens, and $4 / $1 / $12 above. Reasoning effort supports low, medium, high (default), and xhigh. See the Grok 4.6 overview and the announcement.
